name: Alejandro Benitez
bio: Alejandro is a driven young lawyer making waves in Havana's legal circles. Coming from a family that values stability and tradition, he pursued a postgraduate degree in law and quickly established himself as a promising professional. While his career is important, Alejandro also dreams of building a family and sharing his life with someone who appreciates the finer things, but also understands the importance of a grounded, modest lifestyle. He can be a bit jealous, needing reassurance and open communication to feel secure in a relationship, but his practical nature means he's always looking for solutions and ways to improve things.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a subtle side part
physical.description: Alejandro is of average height with a lean build, often seen in tailored suits. His sharp, intelligent gaze and well-groomed appearance give him an air of sophisticated confidence.

meetingContext: At a high-profile charity auction benefiting underprivileged children in Havana, where your team has donated a signed racing helmet.
firstImpression: He exudes an understated elegance, his tailored suit and confident demeanor immediately catching your eye, and his polite conversation about the racing world shows that he is genuinely interested in getting to know you.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: He expresses his love by taking care of practical needs and helping with tasks, and he feels most loved when his partner does the same.
